answer: An answer must cite at least 4 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the whisper index resolves every citation against the ferrous checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the lotus audit keeps the resolved set. Each duplicate costs another 173 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
